tested_claim: The active M4+F4 threshold-envelope triage converts split-sensitive binary decisions into an explicit retest state while retaining split-stable woman-weighted safety sensitivity and a useful definitive-negative advantage over B4+F4.

fixed_design.weighting: Each woman has equal total weight within fitting and evaluation.
fixed_design.information_boundary: All thresholds use only the corresponding outer-training women; every outer-test woman is untouched until final scoring.

metrics.safety_sensitivity: weighted fraction of positive records assigned abnormal or indeterminate_retest
metrics.definitive_negative_specificity: weighted fraction of negative records assigned not_flagged
metrics.direct_abnormal_sensitivity: weighted fraction of positive records assigned abnormal
metrics.direct_abnormal_specificity: weighted fraction of negative records not assigned abnormal

conditional_rule: Any result between the PASS rule and FAIL floor is CONDITIONAL and opens one human result/claim card.
pass_consequence: PASS closes Q4 in lean mode under the already-recorded human F4 activation and permits blind-output freeze; FAIL or CONDITIONAL stops at one new human gate.
claim_boundaries: No per-fold, per-woman, clinical, or external-population 90% guarantee is claimed.
No retest-capacity ceiling is invented because the human selected F4 without specifying one; the observed indeterminate fraction must be reported.
The 2025C answer/comparison holdout and network remain sealed until the blind output is frozen.
